changes: Reordered map information: human site name, local checklist, dated public evidence, Quick Access, then optional metadata.
Removed company code and imported physical progress percent from primary map list, without changing underlying project master.
Added strict status grouping of existing source-attributed dated Daily Ops progress: ONGOING, DONE, BLOCKED/ON_HOLD only. Other status strings are not reclassified.
Recorded HOLD/readiness separately from activity status; no inference of engineering acceptance or site completion.
Kept technical PK/FK identities and classification under a collapsed opt-in disclosure.
Added explicit user-visible source-date and no-construction-certification limitations.
Added desktop/mobile regression tests for the site header, checklist continuity, P001 reported done, P003 ongoing and P004 reported hold.
protected_domains: Google Drive originals and provider extracts
site-operations.html browser checklist and localStorage key
limitations: Dated observations cannot be represented as current site assignments.
Unavailable or unverified status does not mean zero work or a completed project.
Technical metadata is collapsed in UI but still publicly accessible within GitHub Pages source; confidential access requires authenticated project data.
Detailed work registry currently has no published rows, so source-attributed Daily Ops observations are shown and labeled as reported.
rollback: Restore source file blobs from pre_change_archive_root with a new commit. Never reset main or delete originals.
